name: crew
description: Registers six specialist subagents: code-reader and research on Haiku; designer, developer and tester on Sonnet; architect on Opus. Optionally lets Jev (TypeSafe) move each call's model and effort one step from those defaults; that sends a redacted, truncated prompt to api.typesafe.ai.

jevRouting.title: Jev routing of model and effort
jevRouting.description: Lets Jev (TypeSafe) choose the model and effort of each crew:* Agent call, one step from the agent's default and never below the architect's Sonnet floor. Off by default: with it on, the call's description and its prompt (secrets and paths removed, cut to 4000 characters) are sent to api.typesafe.ai. The agent type is never changed, and a call that names a model keeps it. A repository's own settings cannot turn it on.

jevKey.title: Jev API key (TypeSafe)
jevKey.description: Last fallback for the TypeSafe key, used only when jevRouting is on: TYPESAFE_API_KEY, JEV_API_KEY and ~/.jev-router.env are read first. The key is sent only in the Authorization header to api.typesafe.ai and is never logged or stored by the plugin.
